notes: The documents for international applicants are listed on the application page, but the quotes do not name individual documents in a way that meets the evidence requirement (e.g., 'certificate from Institute for International Students' is not a standard document name), so the documents fact is omitted. The application channel is listed as university-direct on the university's international application page; the DAAD page's link (https://www.hs-albsig-international.de//application) confirms this. The deadline of 15 July is for the winter semester; the quote from the application page ('from 1st of May until 15 July for the winter term') lacks a year, so the intake is left out as per the rules.
